category_title: Students with autism who communicate via typing and require significant wait time for responses
scenario_title: Facilitating peer interaction during group work
minimal_context: Shaffer is sitting in the front row during a class period to participate in group work with his classmates.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Shaffer, it is time for group work. Please discuss the assignment with the classmates at your table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits as a silent young man in the front row staring straight ahead, tapping his thumbs together.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and start talking to them.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Types slowly) I think it’s so difficult to initiate conversation questions if you don’t have a teacher in the introduction.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am sitting right here next to you. Just tell them your thoughts.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues staring straight ahead and tapping his thumbs together, unable to connect with the other kids) I look to an adult to really make the bridge... adults must quietly step into the background, camouflaging their help.
